column3: vājapeye surāgrahān gṛhṇāti sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāgrahān gṛhṇātīti vākyadvayena prathamavarṇikasya yathāvācanikam eva
tathā cāyam arthaḥ vājapeye tu grahaṇamātrasyaivābhyanujñānaṃ prāśanābhyanujñānaṃ tu tṛtīyavarṇasyaiva tathā
sautrāmaṇyāṃ tu yāgakartur eva prāśanaṃ nigamavākyenābhidhīyate netareṣām ṛtvijām tatrāpy āghrāṇenaiva prāśanapratipattir iti
sārvakālikābhyanujñānaṃ tu rasādhipatīnām eva nānyeṣāṃ janānām iti prakaraṇārtham upasaṃharati ||
khaṇḍamaṇḍalādhipatyādīnām iti ||
alpaviṣayasya śāsanakartṝṇāṃ rājñāṃ lokamātur anugraheṇa paripūritānāṃ sīdhugrahaṇena vilāsānubhavaḥ vilāsānām
yuvatīnāṃ prāśane niyamavidhiṃ saṃpradarśayati ||
svakīyapriyasāhacaryeṇeti ||
nidhuvanakāle eva svapatibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kādambarasvīkaraṇasyābhyanujñānaṃ netarāvasthāyāṃ kutaḥ upayogābhāvāt
niyamavidhāv api kiṃcid viśeṣāntaram anubadhnāti ||
tatrāpi ananyajamakheṣv eveti ||
ananyajena kriyamāṇeṣu makheṣv eva atyāvaśyakatvena anutarṣasvīkaraṇavidhānaṃ netaratra tadatiriktakāleṣv iti ||
yoṣāyāḥ atra yoṣāsaṃgraheṇa upaśyāmādīnām eva saṃgrahaḥ na vibhraṃśitadvitīyāvasthānām āsyapadmena prāśanaṃ tu
yoṣāyāḥ āsyapadmeneti ||
yoṣāyāḥ āsyapadmena prāśane kriyamāṇe yathecchikī bhāṣāyāḥ anusphurtir bhavatīty arthaḥ ||
anena vākyena śravaṇādivyavasāyarahite .pi jane niṣprayāsenaiva tridaśānāṃ gīḥ svamukhāt prādurbhūyata ity arthaḥ ||
anyad apy utkṛṣṭataraṃ phalaviśeṣāntaraṃ svīkāramātreṇa saṃpradarśayati ||
śyāmāyā āsyasahasrapattrād iti ||

column3: śyāmāyāḥ kamalaprasūnāt anuprāśanaṃ pratyakṣānubhavena sākṣāt mūlaprakṛteḥ svarūpānudarśane hetuḥ kāraṇam iti tayā saha
yad vā tatsvarūpaṃ sākṣād avyavadhānena paśyatīty arthaḥ ||
anena vākyena sāyujyādikaṃ phalam api nirāyāsena prāpnotīty arthaḥ ||
ratikāle sīdhupānaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhibodhitam ||
tat purastāt kāmaśāstre proktaṃ krīḍānuvarṇanam ||
tat sarvaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ yoṣāyāḥ sukhalabdhaye ||
svasyāpi sukhabodhāya apatyotpattihetave ||
phaladvayaṃ sa prāpnoti prajāṃ kāmasukhaṃ tathā ||
urvaśīlokam āpnoti antakāle tu saḥ pumān ||
iti śrīmahārājarṣivaryeṇa purūravasā viracitaṃ kāmijanānāṃ vinodāya rativilāsāṅgabhūtaṃ kādambarasvīkaraṇasūtraṃ
